Michael Jordan once invented an insult to fuel his anger.

Kevin explains how Jordan would find a rival who slighted him, get mad, and use that anger to win the next game.

In one story, a player smirked and said "Nice game, Mike." Jordan stewed for two days, then beat that team.

Then he admitted it never happened. He made it up to motivate himself.

Kevin's point: Jordan created a little pain on purpose to drive himself toward the championship.

What would you use as your fuel?
